India's Coal Imports Show Mixed Trends in August

India's coal imports saw a marginal increase for imported fuel-based power plants in August, while overall coal imports declined by 5.83 percent in the same month, indicating a reduced dependence on foreign supplies. The year of the data is stated as 2026 in one report.
